_README: Recorded Apple Vision body-pose skeletons for the Epic-3 Layer-1 regression test (Issue #21). Frame is Vision NATIVE -- normalized, lower-left origin (y-up), x toward the image's right, anatomical labels -- i.e. the VisionPoseAdapter INPUT, pre-mirror. Each is the output of VNDetectHumanBodyPoseRequest run on the committed shared/native_fixtures/pose_<name>.png (the MPFB CC0 renders) during Layer-2 calibration; see ios/Tests/VisionCalibrationTests.swift and shared/native_fixtures/NATIVE-FIXTURES.md. Replayed through VisionPoseAdapter, these must satisfy the same invariants.json the live calibration asserts -- the fast, camera-free, per-commit guard on the iOS adapter (the Layer-2 test re-derives them live on the simulator). Values are [x, y, confidence]. Regenerate by re-running the generator and extracting the skeletons.
_frame: Vision native: normalized [0,1], lower-left origin (y-up), x to image right, anatomical L/R labels.
